title: Zesty Smoky German Sausage Skewers
description: A quick and flavorful German dish featuring smoky sausage, Tabasco sauce, and a dairy-free friendly recipe, all cooked to perfection on a robata-grill.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: button or cremini, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Tabasco sauce, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice.
Add the sliced onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the German sausage, onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the robata-grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausage is browned and cooked through.
Brush the skewers with the remaining marinade during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or chives if desired.
